seo.title: Nimsara Gamage — Software Engineer, Full-Stack & DevOps | Sri Lanka

principles.title: Problem before stack
principles.body: Start from what has to be true for the people using the system, then choose the tools. The stack is a consequence, not a premise.
principles.practice: Works across PHP, Go, TypeScript, Python and Java.

principles.title: Clear boundaries
principles.body: A service, a tenant or a team should have an edge you can point to. Clean seams make a system easier to change and its failures easier to contain.
principles.practice: Laravel and Go microservices; multi-tenant database design.

principles.title: Design for failure
principles.body: Deploys fail, networks partition, dependencies time out. Decide in advance what happens then, and make the system say so.
principles.practice: Owns production deployment on Linux, Docker and MicroK8s with CI/CD.

principles.title: Make the trade-off explicit
principles.body: Maintainability, performance and delivery pull against each other. Choose the balance on purpose, and say which way it leans.
principles.practice: At Ceylon Linux: 40% faster queries alongside legacy PHP maintenance.

principles.title: Leave it legible
principles.body: A system is only as good as the next engineer's ability to understand and operate it. Code review and mentoring are part of the build.
principles.practice: Mentors junior developers through code review and technical interviews.
